headings: ROSE ET PIVOINE SCENTED INCENSE STICKS AND HOLDER SET

jsonld_raw.name: ROSE ET PIVOINE SCENTED INCENSE STICKS AND HOLDER SET
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented incense sticks that gradually release their fragrance throughout the room, with a ceramic holder.

Holder made of travertine marble.

Rose et Pivoine | A veil of mystery dances in every drop of this creation. The warm, golden embrace of saffron, the majesty of oud, the luminous freshness of bergamot, and the ethereal whisper of sacred incense. A perfume that elevates the soul, igniting an inner fire that illuminates the most memorable nights of celebration.

Notes:
Top notes: saffron, cumin.
Heart notes: guaiac wood, oud, cedarwood.
Base notes: musk, vetiver, incense.
